name: Guardian Poised Reinforcement grants block value on every block below 75% health
contract: Follow-up of #156 (PR #5213). Poised Reinforcement 653278 reads 'Reinforce your shield with magic, causing blocking attacks while below 75% health to grant you $653305s1% increased block value for $653305d.' - no chance is stated. It is SPELL_EFFECT_ENCHANT_ITEM_TEMPORARY (shield only) with SpellItemEnchantment 1018, whose effect 0 is ITEM_ENCHANTMENT_TYPE_EQUIP_SPELL 653410: a hidden passive PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL aura for 653305 (MOD_SHIELD_BLOCKVALUE_PCT 25, 5 s). Server proc data: spell_proc ProcFlags 40, HitMask 8256 (block, full block) with Chance 0, so the chance fell back to 653410's Spell.dbc ProcChance 30; aura_ascension_guardian_event requires a block while the owner is below 75% health and casts 653305. 30 is the shield-reinforcement family template value (Weighted 653409 and Magic 653304 carry it without proccing, Spiked 653386 had it until #156), the one family member with a real chance states it in its tooltip (Jagged 653279, '$653281h% chance'), and the previous Poised Reinforcement 280415 with the same unconditional wording used aura 280416 with ProcChance 100. Expected: every blocked melee attack taken below 75% health grants 653305, and none above 75% health. The harness cannot cast a spell on an item target, so the equipped enchant's aura 653410 is applied as a fixture; QA Test 100% Block 10021 makes every frontal swing a block and the attacker's hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries. With a 30% chance the proc/swing ratio is about 0.3, so the 0.8 lower bound fails before the fix.
